headlines.text: Fed's two-day policy meeting underway, with Wednesday's 2pm ET decision widely expected to hold rates at 3.75%-4.00%
Broadcom shares jump ~4% as Wall Street banks and Blackstone line up $63 billion in financing for its AI chips destined for Anthropic
Nasdaq closes up 1.14% to 26,467 on the chip-stock rally, S&P 500 gains 0.57%, Dow roughly flat as Boeing's slide offsets
UPS tops Q3 estimates with revenue up 6.7% to $22.9 billion and raises full-year EPS and free-cash-flow guidance
Boeing shares sink about 9% after a wider-than-expected Q3 loss and a delay to its 737 MAX production ramp-up until late 2027
GM to shift its stock listing from the NYSE to the Nasdaq Global Select Market, with trading starting there November 17
Alphabet and Microsoft report earnings after the bell Wednesday, Amazon follows Thursday, as Wall Street scrutinizes AI capex
